caption: The drawing features three stylized animal figures, arranged vertically on a beige background bordered by a darker brownish edge. At the top, there is a yellow-orange deer with blue antlers and an open red mouth; the entire body is outlined in red. In the middle, there is a blue animal with the body shape of a quadruped, featuring a bird-like head, a red eye, gold semicircle shapes along its side, and blue branch-like antlers with red leaf or flame shapes extending from them. At the bottom, there is a red deer with a blue eye and blue antlers, featuring a series of yellow and blue swirling patterns along its body. All animals are arranged as if in mid-leap, facing right, and their colors are bold and solid with no shading.
title: Drawing for Plate 3: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
